milestone.name: P4 release assurance
milestone.objective: Produce current release evidence and establish whether version 1.1.1 can pass trusted internal production gates.

lastCompletedWork.summary: Completed the governed skill-update workflow, separated new-skill and existing-skill ownership, propagated deterministic help and routing, refreshed the 45-skill documentation and evidence, and added the project-created video handoff to the 11-slide Demo Day deck.

decisions.decision: Retain P4 release assurance as the blocked overarching milestone.
decisions.rationale: Agent Builder and demo work do not satisfy or supersede trusted signing, independent review, internal artifact, revocation, and production-verification gates.
It records and validates publication intent; Microsoft Foundry and platform-specific workflows own resource creation, endpoint mutation, channel publication, and Custom GPT integration.
A Foundry endpoint is managed with the agent, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams use direct Foundry distribution, and ChatGPT requires a separately governed Custom GPT HTTPS/OpenAPI action.

decisions.decision: Use blueprint schema 2.2 and plan schema 1.1 only when publication intent is present.
decisions.rationale: This preserves compatibility with blueprint schemas 1.0, 2.0, and 2.1 and plan schema 1.0 while adding strict target-specific publication review state.

decisions.decision: Require all six consequential-action approval gates in schema 2.1 and 2.2 autonomy policies.
decisions.rationale: Publication intent must not weaken purchase, booking, messaging, account-security, sensitive-disclosure, or destructive-action approval controls.

decisions.decision: Make the PowerPoint the primary version 1.1.1 demo deck and retain HTML as the animated fallback.
decisions.rationale: The attached presentation remains directly usable for a live audience while the synchronized browser deck retains motion and narration.

decisions.decision: Represent publication planning and release status literally.
decisions.rationale: The deck says Agent Builder creates no external resource and labels P4, signing, independent review, artifact health, and revocation as release blockers.

decisions.decision: Proceed with one normal commit and configured branch push.
decisions.rationale: The user explicitly requested commit and push; policy permits only the reviewed boundary and prohibits force, release, deployment, publication, signing, and Azure mutation.

validation.evidence: The contract distinguishes a managed Foundry endpoint, direct Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams distribution, and separately governed ChatGPT Action integration.

validation.check: Focused Agent Builder and contract tests
validation.evidence: All 33 tests passed, including 17 Agent Builder tests for publication planning, invalid combinations, approval-gate omissions, Azure Government generation, sanitization, and rendered-instruction isolation.
The package-install test verified the updated skill, runtime, schemas, and root CLI flags in the packaged framework and a newly generated project.

The final 11-slide 16:9 deck opened through desktop PowerPoint; slide 3 contains the validated project-created video hyperlink, and focused tests enforce all eleven slide parts and the external OOXML relationship.
Focused contract tests passed, and generated-project validation confirmed one help prompt per skill including skill-update-help.prompt.md.
Final npm run check passed 124 tests with one platform-specific skip and verified all 45 framework skills.
The final gate scanned 220 files with no security failure and zero package dependencies.
The unsigned candidate contains 160 checksum-covered verified files; signing and production release remain blocked.
The prepared boundary contains no staged or unmerged paths, and git diff --check passed without errors.
Operational artifact health and revocation, trusted signature, distinct independent review, and production verification remain blocked.

worktree.attribution: All detected paths are attributable to Agent Builder autonomy and publication planning, synchronized demo collateral, focused tests, generated validation evidence, clarification, policy, change review, and project continuity. The PowerPoint is the only newly added path.

blockers: AUD-0205 production release assurance remains unresolved.
Trusted signing and distinct independent-review identities are absent.
No restricted internal artifact destination, installation-health signal, or tested revocation operation exists.
Required human source review awaits a second qualified collaborator.
Azure Government publication readiness remains blocked wherever current service, channel, authorization, or data-boundary availability is unknown.
pendingApprovals: Trusted signing by a controlled identity and independent review by a distinct qualified reviewer remain required.

Pull request creation, merge, release, Foundry agent creation or endpoint mutation, Bot Service creation, Microsoft 365 or Teams publication, Custom GPT creation or sharing, GPT Action configuration, deployment, and MCP installation each require separate approval.
limitations: The focused suite does not exercise simultaneous lock contention between two live apply processes.
No live Foundry endpoint, Microsoft 365 or Teams channel, Bot Service resource, Custom GPT, or GPT Action was created or exercised.
No signing, release, publication, deployment, hosted-agent creation, MCP installation, or Azure mutation is authorized by this handoff.

nextAction.action: After the authorized branch update, obtain the distinct qualified reviewer, controlled signer, restricted artifact destination, installation-health evidence, and revocation evidence required before resuming P4 release assurance.
prerequisites: Preserve the reviewed Agent Builder and demo commit without force-pushing.
Provision separate signing and reviewing identities.
Establish and test restricted artifact health and revocation controls before production verification.
